items.statement: Protocol A capture: LOCAL_REF_SET (25 refs, 4020 commits); 51 matches = 3 EXECUTION-TRACE · 47 DOC-OR-GOVERNANCE · 1 UNCLASSIFIABLE. The earliest EXECUTION-TRACE is e4724a44 at 2026-08-04T00:30:25Z, 'WP-4C-1 batch B1 -- RED for K1..K4', RECORDING_ORDER only. Further traces: 939e35dc, and cc1a3394, which is substantively WP-6 work (Protocol A limitation L1; not epistemic level L1). No conformance, hypothesis or falsifier statement is made.

Protocol B: no locally checkable channel qualifies as an independent norm-in-force record (F-B1). The overlap test has almost no power, so NOT_INDEPENDENT means 'no evidence of role separation', not 'evidence of role fusion' (F-B2). The only open candidates are the host-side channels and the 23 K-SIG signatures (F-B3).

RETURN-02 (within-family re-coding; frozen comparator): a context-isolated fresh Claude subagent re-coded the 36 records; the comparator compared them with CODING.json. 36/36 ids (none missing, none extra). act.state: agreement 1.000, κ 1.000. norm.deontic: agreement 1.000, κ 1.000. Membership 24 both / 7 NORM-only / 2 ACT-only / 3 neither. UNKNOWN share 0.083 (the 3 no-span records). REF-CR = REF-C, because the 7 unapplied corrections all target *.status.* fields, which the comparator does not apply. The comparator labels itself 'symmetric comparison; Claude references are NOT ground truth'. RETURN-02 'does not show cross-family independence'; the perfect agreement 'is not evidence against correlated error'. Ceiling: at most 'within-family reproducibility of act.state / norm.deontic / membership on these 36 records is high'.

items.statement: Corpus boundary: a register of rulings, plus a few session logs (up to S0815, 2026-08-15) and one git commit. 36 A′ spans are drawn from it, and source identity is pinned by git blob ids (SOURCE-IDENTITY.txt, which is not in this directory). Captures: local refs only (25 refs, 4020 commits); host completeness not shown.

R-SELF: the recommended rule is path-based (a declared programme-artefact root, initially docs/knowledgeos/, listed in a versioned SELF-ROOTS.txt; class SELF-ARTEFACT, excluded from the classes and the earliest trace). Protocol A: 'Not applied' → human decision. 21/51 matches are programme artefacts (DOC-OR-GOVERNANCE 47 vs 27 historical); the ET set is unchanged. Protocol B: .claude/ and claude/ are not excluded. H5: the A and B captures predate R-SELF and are not re-run ('R-SELF applies forward only').

Instrument: A′ is an 'OBSERVATION REPRESENTATION, NOT A THEORY'. It does not assert two ontological layers, H-DEONTIC, or that governed work is out of scope; v1 records are kept unchanged. Under R-A3, act and after-state are the same record. §5: 'Support is computed separately per dataset and never aggregated.'

M-TIME: recording time ≠ decision time ≠ entry into force (three time concepts that must not be equated). Recording time 'is NOT an upper bound on entry into force'; it bounds drafting (PREPARED rulings are written before adoption). Protocol A L3: 'file names are not timestamp sources' (the earliest-trace commit changes a plan file whose name implies 19:00 on 2026-08-04; every recording of it precedes that).

items.statement: H-D and H-B are frozen and stated neutrally. Both accept that norm-making acts exist.
READINESS erratum E4: host membership data shows repository access, not normative capability. At most it is an input to a capability register.

Two sealed expectations failed: (1) 1ba bias check: 'the sealed expectation (C1 CONFORMS / UNDETERMINED) failed'; (2) 1be main-analyst sealed expectation NO 'was not confirmed', 'Recorded as a prediction miss'.

R4 may use the L0 items (A01–A13, A15, G04, G06) with their provenance as data, including each 'as quoted by <file>' disclosure; the L1 items A14 and A16 are coder statements / unverifiable quotes, not L0 data.
R4 may use M-TIME: recording time, decision time and entry into force are three time concepts that must not be equated (not a claim that they always differ).
H-D or H-B as an axiom; hypotheses are never axioms.
Norm → act: authorization is not execution, and prohibition is not refusal.
Non-occurrence from absence; use NOT-EVIDENCED-IN-CAPTURE.
A decision order or entry into force read from recording order.
That an independent norm-state observable exists, or that none exists.
Support aggregated across the ACT and NORM datasets: support is computed separately per dataset and never aggregated.
Host membership (repository access) as normative capability.
